tools.name: shopline_list_products
tools.description: List products in the store, newest first, with title, status, variants and images. Filter by ids, handle, status or creation/update time. Admin REST API: GET /products/products.json (scope read_products).

tools.name: shopline_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with their payment status, fulfillment status, totals and line items. Filter by ids, financial or fulfillment status, search text, or creation/update time. Admin REST API: GET /orders.json (scope read_orders).

tools.name: shopline_list_customers
tools.description: List store customers with their contact details and account data. Filter by ids or creation/update time. Admin REST API: GET /v2/customers.json (scope read_customers).
